title: Forecasting Liquidity Withdraw with Machine Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.22985v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Liquidity withdrawal is a critical indicator of market fragility. In this project, I test a framework for forecasting liquidity withdrawal at the individual-stock level, ranging from less liquid stocks to highly liquid large-cap tickers, and evaluate the relative performance of competing model classes in predicting short-horizon order book stress. We introduce the Liquidity Withdrawal Index (LWI) -- defined as the ratio of order cancellations to the sum of standing depth and new additions at the best quotes -- as a bounded, interpretable measure of transient liquidity removal.   Using Nasdaq market-by-order (MBO) data, we compare a spectrum of approaches: linear benchmarks (AR, HAR), and non-linear tree ensembles (XGBoost), across horizons ranging from 250\,ms to 5\,s. translated_title: 基于机器学习模型的流动性撤回预测
translated_abstract: 流动性撤回是市场脆弱性的关键指标。在本项目中，我测试了一个在个股层面预测流动性撤回的框架，研究对象涵盖流动性较差的股票到高流动性的大盘股，并评估了不同竞争模型类别在预测短期订单簿压力方面的相对表现。我们提出了流动性撤回指数（LWI）——定义为订单取消量与最优报价处的挂单深度和新增加委托量之和的比值——作为衡量瞬时流动性移除的有界且可解释的指标。基于纳斯达克逐笔委托（MBO）数据，我们比较了一系列方法：线性基准模型（AR、HAR）和非线性树集成模型（XGBoost），预测时间跨度从250毫秒到5秒不等。除了预测准确性之外，我们的结果还提供了对订单提交和取消动态的深入洞察，并识别了线性信号与非线性信号各自占主导地位的市场状态。
tldr: 本文提出流动性撤回指数（LWI）作为衡量瞬时流动性移除的有界可解释指标，并基于纳斯达克逐笔委托数据，比较线性模型与XGBoost非线性模型在个股层面预测250毫秒至5秒短期订单簿压力的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Liquidity Withdrawal Index (LWI) as a bounded, interpretable measure of transient liquidity removal and compares linear benchmarks (AR, HAR) with non-linear tree ensembles (XGBoost) using Nasdaq MBO data to forecast short-horizon order book stress at the individual-stock level across 250ms to 5s horizons.
